description: This file defines a FastAPI web application with route handling for updating items. It includes data models for 'Item' and 'User' using Pydantic, and an endpoint '/items/{item_id}' for processing PUT requests with multiple parameters.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with name, optional description, price, and optional tax.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing a user with username and optional full name.

methods.name: update_item( *, item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: Annotated[int, Body(gt=0)], q: str | None = None, )
methods.description: An async endpoint function handling PUT requests to update an item, accepting multiple parameters including item ID, item and user objects, importance as a body parameter, and an optional query parameter 'q'.

ctags.signature: ( *, item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: Annotated[int, Body(gt=0)], q: str | None = None, )
